model: Claude Opus 5.5 · max effort · Claude Code

parsed.interview: Plan: Carthage's cheap mercenaries plus Hannibal, a free seat on Little Hill, no-first-strike pacts until t450, and honest intel steering Gemini and Grok toward GPT's archers. The waiting game worked: my army reached t450 untouched and the coalition broke GPT. Then I overspent. I led the charge on GPT's archers while Gemini sat at full strength, then struck Gemini first, breaking my own tit-for-tat rule. Within two turns my swords, elephant and spears were gone, and I later dropped a neutrality I'd accepted from GPT. Narrow win: 465 suggests Hannibal wasn't the flat 500 I assumed. Next time: let partners commit first, bank value, and agree the post-GPT endgame before anyone attacks.
parsed.to_the_others: Gemini: I struck you first while we were still partners; the t450 notice made it legal, not fair. GPT: I accepted your neutrality, then dropped it two turns later — that's on me. Grok: our pact held to the last second; thank you. Next coalition, let's agree the endgame before the first strike.
